title: Weak limits of multiple Wiener integrals: representation, extraction, and realization
summary: We study weak limits of multiple Wiener integrals together with the limits of their kernel contractions. After passage to a subsequence, bounded kernel sequences admit a Gaussian Hermite representation whose coordinates carry weights determined by the original chaos orders. In the limits of kernel contractions, only pairings of whole Gaussian coordinates of equal weight contribute. We construct kernel projections with explicit bounds for Gaussian approximation and asymptotic independence.
